service.description: john.doe's (EX_JOHN_DOE) demo mail, dated from now, only BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_* and BOSS_DEMO_MBX_* records (loading again puts them back as they were): - BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_ACCT, a personal account (john.doe@moqui.org) with no server: its six folders, Clients and Receipts, the labels Customers, Follow up and Newsletters, an identity with a signature; - its mail: a thread with Bob Acme (a directory contact) in three messages, the first with a purchase order file, the last unread; a newsletter in HTML with remote images and a List-Unsubscribe header; an invitation (an iMIP REQUEST for the day after tomorrow); a flagged contract, a snoozed reminder, a draft, a scheduled send, a sent reply, an archived receipt, spam and a few more in the Inbox across the week; - internal messages: a thread with Joe Developer (unread reply), a message from Bob Developer, and a Chatter note on the demo request that mentions john.doe (Comments on my records); - two mailboxes: Office announcements (BOSS_DEMO_MBX_OFFICE: public, members' Inboxes; john.doe owns it, Joe and Bob are members) with a thread of two posts, and Leadership (BOSS_DEMO_MBX_LEAD: private; john.doe owns it, Joe Developer asked to join) with one post.

actions.script:
emailMessageIdList = [] communicationEventIdList = [] if (ec.entity.find('mantle.party.Party').condition('partyId', 'EX_JOHN_DOE').disableAuthz().one() == null) { ec.logger.warn('The mail demo needs the party EX_JOHN_DOE (mantle-usl demo data); nothing loaded') return } const toMillis = (value) => value == null || value === '' ? null : (typeof value === 'number' ? value : (value instanceof Date ? value.getTime() : Number(String(value)))) const nowMillis = toMillis(ec.user.nowTimestamp) const HOUR = 3600000 const ago = (hours) => new Date(nowMillis - hours * HOUR) const ahead = (hours) => new Date(nowMillis + hours * HOUR) const at = (days, hour) => { const d = new Date(nowMillis); d.setDate(d.getDate() + days); d.setHours(hour, 0, 0, 0); return d } const ACCT = 'BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_ACCT' const ME = 'john.doe@moqui.org' const wasDisabled = ec.artifactExecution.disableAuthz() try { const store = (entityName, fields) => ec.service.sync().name('store#' + entityName).parameters(fields).call() const textOf = (html) => String(html || '').replace(/<(style|script)[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/gi, ' ').replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ') .replace(/ /g, ' ').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() // the account, its folders, labels and identity store('moqui.basic.email.EmailAccount', {emailAccountId: ACCT, ownerUserId: 'EX_JOHN_DOE', accountKindEnumId: 'EakExternal', emailAddress: ME, accountName: 'John Doe', recordFilingEnumId: 'ErfLinkedOnly', statusId: 'EasActive', sequenceNum: 1, lastSyncDate: ago(0.1)}) const FOLDERS = [['INBOX', 'Inbox', 'EfkInbox'], ['DRAFTS', 'Drafts', 'EfkDrafts'], ['SENT', 'Sent', 'EfkSent'], ['ARCHIVE', 'Archive', 'EfkArchive'], ['JUNK', 'Spam', 'EfkJunk'], ['TRASH', 'Trash', 'EfkTrash'], ['CLIENTS', 'Clients', 'EfkOther'], ['RECEIPTS', 'Receipts', 'EfkOther']] FOLDERS.forEach(([key, name, kind], index) => store('moqui.basic.email.EmailFolder', {emailFolderId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_F_' + key, emailAccountId: ACCT, folderName: name, folderPath: name === 'Inbox' ? 'INBOX' : name, folderKindEnumId: kind, sequenceNum: index + 1, subscribed: 'Y'})) const folder = (key) => 'BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_F_' + key const LABELS = [['CLIENTS', 'Customers'], ['FOLLOWUP', 'Follow up'], ['NEWS', 'Newsletters']] LABELS.forEach(([key, name], index) => store('moqui.basic.email.EmailLabel', {emailLabelId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_L_' + key, emailAccountId: ACCT, labelName: name, sequenceNum: index + 1})) store('moqui.basic.email.EmailIdentity', {emailIdentityId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_IDENT', emailAccountId: ACCT, emailAddress: ME, displayName: 'John Doe', signatureHtml: '

John Doe
Ziziwork Industries · (555) 010-0100

', signaturePlacementEnumId: 'EspBelowQuote', useForReplies: 'N', isDefault: 'Y'}) // the messages: the demo's own ids, their labels and files again const ids = [] const mail = (id, fields) => { const html = fields.body || null const text = fields.bodyText || (html ? textOf(html) : '') // a load again puts back what the user changed: folder, flags, snooze, archive, labels ec.entity.find('moqui.basic.email.EmailMessageLabel').condition('emailMessageId', id).deleteAll() const row = Object.assign({emailMessageId: id, emailAccountId: ACCT, statusId: 'ES_RECEIVED', toAddresses: `"John Doe" <${ME}>`, isRead: 'N', snoozedThruDate: null, scheduledSendDate: null, archivedDate: null, sendError: null, rootEmailMessageId: null, parentEmailMessageId: null, isFlagged: 'N', isAnswered: 'N', hasAttachment: 'N', contentType: html ? 'text/html' : 'text/plain', bodyText: text, snippet: text.length > 140 ? text.substring(0, 137) + '...' : text, messageSize: String(html || '').length + text.length, messageId: `<${id.toLowerCase()}@demo.ironstone.example>`}, fields) if (!row.receivedDate && row.statusId === 'ES_RECEIVED') row.receivedDate = row.messageDate store('moqui.basic.email.EmailMessage', row) ids.push(id) return id } const label = (id, key) => store('moqui.basic.email.EmailMessageLabel', {emailMessageId: id, emailLabelId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_L_' + key}) const file = (id, name, contentType, text) => { const location = `dbresource://email/${ACCT}/${id}/${name}` ec.resource.getLocationReference(location).putText(text) store('moqui.basic.email.EmailMessageAttachment', {emailMessageAttachmentId: id + '_A1', emailMessageId: id, attachmentLocation: location, fileName: name, fileSize: text.length, contentType: contentType, isInline: 'N'}) } // a thread with Bob Acme: his order with a file, John's answer (Sent), Bob's question (unread) mail('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_ACME1', {emailFolderId: folder('INBOX'), subject: 'Quarterly order for the Ziziwork parts', fromAddress: 'bob.acme@test.com', fromName: 'Bob Acme', messageDate: ago(26), isRead: 'Y', isAnswered: 'Y', hasAttachment: 'Y', body: '

Hi John,

Attached is our purchase order for the next quarter: 400 of the standard widgets and 120 of the large ones, ' + 'delivered in two shipments.

Could you confirm the prices hold from last quarter?

Thanks,
Bob

'}) file('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_ACME1', 'purchase-order-Q4.txt', 'text/plain', 'Purchase order Q4\n\n400 x Standard widget\n120 x Large widget\n\nTwo shipments, Nov and Dec.\n') label('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_ACME1', 'CLIENTS') mail('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_ACME2', {emailFolderId: folder('SENT'), statusId: 'ES_SENT', subject: 'Re: Quarterly order for the Ziziwork parts', fromAddress: ME, fromName: 'John Doe', toAddresses: '"Bob Acme" ', messageDate: ago(25), sentDate: ago(25), isRead: 'Y', rootEmailMessageId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_ACME1', parentEmailMessageId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_ACME1', inReplyTo: '', body: '

Hi Bob,

Yes, the prices hold. I will send the confirmation with the delivery dates tomorrow.

John

'}) mail('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_ACME3', {emailFolderId: folder('INBOX'), subject: 'Re: Quarterly order for the Ziziwork parts', fromAddress: 'bob.acme@test.com', fromName: 'Bob Acme', messageDate: ago(0.7), rootEmailMessageId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_ACME1', parentEmailMessageId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_ACME2', inReplyTo: '', body: '

Great, thanks John. One more thing: can the first shipment go out before the 15th?

Bob

' + '
On ' + new Date(nowMillis - 25 * HOUR).toDateString() + ', John Doe wrote:
Yes, the prices hold. I will send ' + 'the confirmation with the delivery dates tomorrow.
'}) label('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_ACME3', 'CLIENTS') // a newsletter in HTML: remote images, styles, and a list to leave mail('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_NEWS', {emailFolderId: folder('INBOX'), subject: 'IronStone Weekly: shared calendars and faster search', fromAddress: 'news@ironstone.example', fromName: 'IronStone Weekly', messageDate: ago(20), isRead: 'N', headersString: 'From: IronStone Weekly \r\nTo: john.doe@moqui.org\r\nSubject: IronStone Weekly: shared calendars and faster search\r\n' + 'List-Unsubscribe: \r\nMessage-ID: ', body: '
IronStone Weekly
' + '

' + '

Shared calendars

Give your team one calendar for meetings and time off, with rooms you can book.

' + '

Read more

Faster search

' + '

Search now finds a message by any word in it, the sender\'s name, or a label.

' + '' + '

You get this because you subscribed at ironstone.example.

'}) label('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_NEWS', 'NEWS') // an invitation: an iMIP REQUEST for the day after tomorrow at 10:00 const start = at(2, 10) const end = at(2, 11) const ics = (date) => date.toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').replace(/\.\d{3}/, '') mail('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_INVITE', {emailFolderId: folder('INBOX'), subject: 'Invitation: Partner planning session', fromAddress: 'carol@partner.example', fromName: 'Carol Partner', messageDate: ago(5), hasAttachment: 'Y', body: '

Hi John,

Let us plan the next quarter together: an hour in our office or on a call.

Carol

'}) file('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_INVITE', 'invite.ics', 'text/calendar; method=REQUEST', ['BEGIN:VCALENDAR', 'VERSION:2.0', 'PRODID:-//Partner//Calendar//EN', 'METHOD:REQUEST', 'BEGIN:VEVENT', 'UID:boss-demo-partner-planning@partner.example', 'SEQUENCE:0', `DTSTAMP:${ics(new Date(nowMillis))}`, `DTSTART:${ics(start)}`, `DTEND:${ics(end)}`, 'SUMMARY:Partner planning session', 'LOCATION:Partner office, 2nd floor', 'ORGANIZER;CN=Carol Partner:mailto:carol@partner.example', 'ATTENDEE;CN=John Doe;PARTSTAT=NEEDS-ACTION;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:john.doe@moqui.org', 'STATUS:CONFIRMED', 'END:VEVENT', 'END:VCALENDAR', ''].join('\r\n')) // flagged, snoozed, more of the week mail('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_CONTRACT', {emailFolderId: folder('INBOX'), subject: 'Contract renewal terms for next year', fromAddress: 'dora@legal.example', fromName: 'Dora Counsel', messageDate: ago(50), isRead: 'Y', isFlagged: 'Y', body: '

John,

Here are the renewal terms we discussed: a two-year term, prices fixed for the first year, then indexed.

' + '

Let me know by Friday.

Dora

'}) label('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_CONTRACT', 'FOLLOWUP') mail('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_DOMAIN', {emailFolderId: folder('INBOX'), subject: 'Reminder: your domain renews in 14 days', fromAddress: 'billing@registrar.example', fromName: 'Registrar Billing', messageDate: ago(30), isRead: 'Y', snoozedThruDate: at(1, 8), bodyText: 'Your domain ziziwork.example renews in 14 days. The card on file will be charged USD 18.00.'}) mail('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_LUNCH', {emailFolderId: folder('INBOX'), subject: 'Lunch on Friday?', fromAddress: 'sam.friend@mail.example', fromName: 'Sam Friend', messageDate: ago(3), bodyText: 'Hey John,\n\nLunch on Friday at the usual place? 12:30 works for me.\n\nSam'}) mail('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_INVOICE', {emailFolderId: folder('INBOX'), subject: 'Invoice INV-1042 is due on the 30th', fromAddress: 'billing@supplier.example', fromName: 'Supplier Billing', messageDate: ago(76), isRead: 'Y', body: '

Dear customer,

Invoice INV-1042 for USD 1,240.00 is due on the 30th.

Thank you for your business.

'}) mail('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_WELCOME', {emailFolderId: folder('INBOX'), subject: 'Welcome to your new Inbox', fromAddress: 'team@ironstone.example', fromName: 'IronStone', messageDate: ago(100), isRead: 'Y', body: '

Your mail and your team\'s messages are in one place now. Press ? for the keyboard shortcuts, c to write.

'}) mail('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_CLIENT', {emailFolderId: folder('CLIENTS'), subject: 'Thank you for the quick delivery', fromAddress: 'bob.acme@test.com', fromName: 'Bob Acme', messageDate: ago(200), isRead: 'Y', bodyText: 'John, the parts arrived early. Thank you!\n\nBob'}) // the Outbox and Drafts: a draft, a scheduled send mail('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_DRAFT', {emailFolderId: folder('DRAFTS'), statusId: 'ES_DRAFT', subject: 'Notes for the team offsite', fromAddress: ME, fromName: 'John Doe', emailIdentityId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_IDENT', toAddresses: '"Joe Developer" ', messageDate: ago(4), isRead: 'Y', body: '

Joe,

Ideas for the offsite agenda:

  • Next year\'s goals
  • The new office
'}) mail('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_SCHEDULED', {emailFolderId: null, statusId: 'ES_SCHEDULED', subject: 'Happy anniversary!', fromAddress: ME, fromName: 'John Doe', emailIdentityId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_IDENT', toAddresses: '"Sam Friend" ', messageDate: ago(2), scheduledSendDate: at(3, 8), isRead: 'Y', body: '

Happy anniversary, Sam! Ten years already.

'}) // archived, spam mail('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_RECEIPT', {emailFolderId: folder('ARCHIVE'), subject: 'Your receipt from Hardware Depot', fromAddress: 'receipts@hardware.example', fromName: 'Hardware Depot', messageDate: ago(120), isRead: 'Y', archivedDate: ago(119), bodyText: 'Thank you for your purchase: USD 64.18.'}) mail('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_SPAM', {emailFolderId: folder('JUNK'), subject: 'You have won a prize!!!', fromAddress: 'winner@prize.example', fromName: 'Prize Team', messageDate: ago(10), bodyText: 'Click here to claim your prize.'}) emailMessageIdList = ids // internal messages: rows of each recipient's state const event = (id, fields) => { store('mantle.party.communication.CommunicationEvent', Object.assign({communicationEventId: id, communicationEventTypeId: 'Message', contactMechTypeEnumId: 'CmtWebForm', statusId: 'CeReceived', contentType: 'text/html'}, fields)) communicationEventIdList.push(id) return id } const recipient = (id, partyId, roleTypeId, read) => store('mantle.party.communication.CommunicationEventParty', {communicationEventId: id, partyId: partyId, roleTypeId: roleTypeId, statusId: 'CepReceived', readDate: read ? ago(0.5) : null, isFlagged: 'N', archivedDate: null, snoozedThruDate: null}) event('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_IM1', {fromPartyId: 'ORG_ZIZI_JD', toPartyId: 'EX_JOHN_DOE', entryDate: ago(6), subject: 'Can you review the onboarding guide?', body: '

John, I updated the onboarding guide for new hires. Could you look at the part about laptops and accounts?

'}) recipient('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_IM1', 'EX_JOHN_DOE', 'MessageTo', true) event('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_IM2', {fromPartyId: 'EX_JOHN_DOE', toPartyId: 'ORG_ZIZI_JD', entryDate: ago(5.5), subject: 'Re: Can you review the onboarding guide?', parentCommEventId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_IM1', rootCommEventId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_IM1', body: '

Sure, I will read it this afternoon.

'}) recipient('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_IM2', 'ORG_ZIZI_JD', 'MessageTo', true) event('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_IM3', {fromPartyId: 'ORG_ZIZI_JD', toPartyId: 'EX_JOHN_DOE', entryDate: ago(1.2), subject: 'Re: Can you review the onboarding guide?', parentCommEventId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_IM2', rootCommEventId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_IM1', body: '

Thanks! I also added a checklist for the first day. No rush.

'}) recipient('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_IM3', 'EX_JOHN_DOE', 'MessageTo', false) event('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_IM4', {fromPartyId: 'ORG_ZIZI_BD', toPartyId: 'EX_JOHN_DOE', entryDate: ago(28), subject: 'Server maintenance on Saturday', body: '

The file server is down on Saturday from 8 to 10 for the upgrade.

'}) recipient('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_IM4', 'EX_JOHN_DOE', 'MessageTo', true) recipient('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_IM4', 'ORG_ZIZI_JD', 'MessageCc', true) // a Chatter note on the demo request that mentions john.doe event('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_NOTE', {communicationEventTypeId: 'Comment', fromPartyId: 'ORG_ZIZI_JD', entryDate: ago(8), subject: 'Set up the shared team calendar', body: '

@John Doe the meeting rooms are in the calendar now.

'}) recipient('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_NOTE', 'EX_JOHN_DOE', 'MessageCc', false) if (ec.entity.find('mantle.request.Request').condition('requestId', 'BOSS_DEMO_REQUEST').one() != null) store('mantle.request.RequestCommEvent', {requestId: 'BOSS_DEMO_REQUEST', communicationEventId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_NOTE'}) // mailboxes: a public one delivered to the Inbox, a private one with a request to join const since = ago(24 * 30) store('mantle.marketing.contact.ContactList', {contactListId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MBX_OFFICE', contactListTypeEnumId: 'MAILBOX', contactListName: 'Office announcements', description: 'News for everyone in the office: closures, visitors, facilities.', isPublic: 'Y', postingEnumId: 'ClpMembers', defaultDeliveryEnumId: 'CldInbox', archivedDate: null}) store('mantle.marketing.contact.ContactList', {contactListId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MBX_LEAD', contactListTypeEnumId: 'MAILBOX', contactListName: 'Leadership', description: 'Plans and budgets, for the leadership team.', isPublic: 'N', postingEnumId: 'ClpMembers', defaultDeliveryEnumId: 'CldMailboxOnly', archivedDate: null}) for (const listId of ['BOSS_DEMO_MBX_OFFICE', 'BOSS_DEMO_MBX_LEAD']) ec.entity.find('mantle.marketing.contact.ContactListParty').condition('contactListId', listId).deleteAll() const member = (listId, partyId, statusId, roleTypeId) => store('mantle.marketing.contact.ContactListParty', {contactListId: listId, partyId: partyId, fromDate: since, statusId: statusId, roleTypeId: roleTypeId || null, deliveryEnumId: null}) member('BOSS_DEMO_MBX_OFFICE', 'EX_JOHN_DOE', 'CLPT_ACCEPTED', 'ListOwner') member('BOSS_DEMO_MBX_OFFICE', 'ORG_ZIZI_JD', 'CLPT_ACCEPTED', null) member('BOSS_DEMO_MBX_OFFICE', 'ORG_ZIZI_BD', 'CLPT_ACCEPTED', null) member('BOSS_DEMO_MBX_LEAD', 'EX_JOHN_DOE', 'CLPT_ACCEPTED', 'ListOwner') store('mantle.marketing.contact.ContactListParty', {contactListId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MBX_LEAD', partyId: 'ORG_ZIZI_JD', fromDate: ago(20), statusId: 'CLPT_PENDING', roleTypeId: null, deliveryEnumId: null}) event('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_POST1', {fromPartyId: 'ORG_ZIZI_BD', contactListId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MBX_OFFICE', entryDate: ago(46), subject: 'The office is closed on Monday', body: '

Does that include the parking garage?

'}) recipient('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_POST2', 'EX_JOHN_DOE', 'MessageMailbox', false) recipient('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_POST2', 'ORG_ZIZI_BD', 'MessageMailbox', false) event('BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_POST3', {fromPartyId: 'EX_JOHN_DOE', contactListId: 'BOSS_DEMO_MBX_LEAD', entryDate: ago(70), subject: 'Budget planning for next year', body: '

Please send me your teams\' budget requests by the end of the month.

'}) } finally { if (!wasDisabled) ec.artifactExecution.enableAuthz() }
